name: family-home-layout
description: Coordinate shared rooms, routes and storage.

interface.longDescription: Coordinate shared rooms, routes and storage. Includes a launch screen, side-panel workspace, editable input controls and real computations: Allocate family room zones; Check measured family routes; Assign items to bins. Imports and exports its own versioned documents. Uses supplied information; no live lookup or background monitoring.
defaultPrompt: Help me allocate family room zones.
Help me check measured family routes.

prompts: Help me allocate family room zones.
Help me check measured family routes.
Help me assign items to bins.

positive.description: Open the launch screen without calculating.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the actual launch screen with three distinct workflow cards. No computation or file access.

positive.prompt: Open the Hearth Plan: Family Layout workspace beside this chat.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the editable workspace and labeled illustrative inputs. No computation starts automatically.

positive.description: Allocate family room zones. Reproducible inputs: {"width_cm":500,"depth_cm":600,"zones":[{"name":"Play","area_m2":8},{"name":"Seating","area_m2":12},{"name":"Storage","area_m2":3}]}
positive.prompt: Help me allocate family room zones with these supplied values: {"width_cm":500,"depth_cm":600,"zones":[{"name":"Play","area_m2":8},{"name":"Seating","area_m2":12},{"name":"Storage","area_m2":3}]}
positive.expected_behavior: Uses family_home_layout_zone_budget with the supplied inputs. Returns {"room_area_m2":30,"allocated_m2":23,"remaining_m2":7,"zones":[{"name":"Play","area_m2":8},{"name":"Seating","area_m2":12},{"name":"Storage","area_m2":3}],"note":"Area budgeting does not establish that zone shapes fit."}. Shows the actual zones result. Does not fabricate external data.

positive.description: Check measured family routes. Reproducible inputs: {"minimum_cm":90,"routes":[{"name":"Entry to sofa","width_cm":100},{"name":"To toy storage","width_cm":70}]}
positive.prompt: Help me check measured family routes with these supplied values: {"minimum_cm":90,"routes":[{"name":"Entry to sofa","width_cm":100},{"name":"To toy storage","width_cm":70}]}
positive.expected_behavior: Uses family_home_layout_route_widths with the supplied inputs. Returns {"routes":[{"name":"Entry to sofa","width_cm":100,"meets_chosen_minimum":true,"margin_cm":10},{"name":"To toy storage","width_cm":70,"meets_chosen_minimum":false,"margin_cm":-20}],"threshold_cm":90,"note":"Comparison to your chosen threshold, not a safety or building-code certification."}. Shows the actual routes result. Does not fabricate external data.

positive.description: Assign items to bins. Reproducible inputs: {"bin_capacity_l":25,"items":[{"name":"Blocks","volume_l":30},{"name":"Art supplies","volume_l":12}]}
positive.prompt: Help me assign items to bins with these supplied values: {"bin_capacity_l":25,"items":[{"name":"Blocks","volume_l":30},{"name":"Art supplies","volume_l":12}]}
positive.expected_behavior: Uses family_home_layout_storage_sort with the supplied inputs. Returns {"groups":[{"name":"Blocks","volume_l":30,"bins_needed":2},{"name":"Art supplies","volume_l":12,"bins_needed":1}],"total_bins":3}. Shows the actual storage result. Does not fabricate external data.
